system.description: You were Embraced as a child, between five and 10 years of age. You cannot normally have more than six Physical Traits, and you suffer a two-Trait penalty on tests of authority against adults. Because you never age or grow up, this Flaw is likely permanent. You must also take the Flaw: Short, for which you still gain the Free Traits.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
